userDecision.approach: Flattened product styles.css; CSS vars on :root/.dark; demo swaps stylesheet; Theme JS initColorScheme uses prefers-color-scheme until persistColorScheme. Reset (port of src/styles/reset.css, no bundled fonts) then typography (element defaults + type-style classes) appended to styles.css by build-product.mjs and mirrored to an ESM string for Shadow DOM. Reset, shipped elements, and demo components use Harmony color, spacing, radius, border-width, shadow, and transition tokens instead of literal styling values.
userDecision.consumerApi: styles.css = tokens + Harmony reset + typography type styles/classes; var(--*); typography classes ported from reference utilities.css (.text-display-*, .text-heading-*, .text-body-*, .text-label, .text-caption, .text-overline, .font-*, .text-xs..5xl, .leading-*); element defaults h1-h6 -> Heading XL..S, p -> Body Default, label -> Label, small -> Caption, code/pre/kbd/samp -> mono, strong/b -> semibold; typographySheet + typographyCss (reset + typography) for Shadow DOM; setColorScheme/getColorScheme/toggleColorScheme/initColorScheme/persistColorScheme; no foundation Custom Elements; no JS token modules
gaps: Demo compares products via stylesheet swap not multi-palette page (accepted)
Decorative Icons as inline SVG until Icon synced (accepted)
Element defaults deviate from reference reset.css, which gives h1-h6 display font/bold/tight with browser sizes and no type-style size (user approved 2026-09-09: heading-first tag mapping)
Display type styles are class-only — no tag maps to Display (user approved 2026-09-09)
No .leading-snug or .font-extrabold class — matches reference utilities.css (accepted)
Reset omits Google Fonts @import from reference reset.css — host loads fonts (accepted)
Reset adds `pre code { color: inherit }` (reference omits it) so a themed pre is not overridden by the inline code color; renders identically under reference tokens

Reset enumerates the margin/padding reset (`:where(body, h1-h6, p, ul, ol, pre, fieldset, table, form controls, ...)`) instead of the reference `* { margin: 0; padding: 0 }`: a universal rule in the document tree also matches Custom Elements, and normal document declarations beat a shadow root's `:host` rules, so `*` zeroed the host padding/margin of every shipped element. Same result for plain HTML

Reset keeps list markers (`ul` disc, `ol` decimal, `padding-inline-start: var(--space-6)`) instead of the reference `ul, ol { list-style: none }` (user requested 2026-09-09: lists should read as lists). Components that use a list for structure — nav, tab strip, menu — set `list-style: none` in their own styles. Nested `ul` stays disc rather than the browser circle/square ramp
